annotations.title: Create an app with a hosted webhook URL

description: Create a hosted webhook inbox in your connected account. Give the sender the returned inbound URL. Omit destinations to store deliveries for inspection. The URL keeps receiving between sessions. After reconnecting the same account, anyhook_events lists deliveries for the app slug and anyhook_inspect reads a payload.

api_key.description: Legacy field, ignored. Connect with ANYHOOK_API_KEY in the stdio client configuration.

destinations.description: Destination URLs that should receive forwarded events.

source.description: Optional provider name (stripe, github, shopify, ...). Leave it out to accept any sender: naming one makes the edge refuse (401) requests without that provider's signature header, curl tests included.

name: anyhook_apps_create
